name: Khaitan (India) Limited
about: Khaitan (India) Limited engages in trading of electrical goods primarily in India. It operates through three segments: Electrical Goods, Sugar, and Agriculture. The company offers fans, geyser and light products, cables, wires, switchgears, switches, motors, industrial air circulators, air coolers, pumps, electric FHP motors, and electrical accessories for use in infrastructure, industrial, housing, and commercial projects. It also provides agricultural and sugar products. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Kolkata, India.
